vibe_rationale: Genuine gravel riding community, but a participation ride first and culture second, with thin evidence and a tyre-brand naming partner.
fit_notes: Adult endurance riders with a clear active-lifestyle and hydration angle, though the field is small (107 riders). Panaracer holds the naming slot, so access is scored locked, though a secondary partner slot may exist. Japan-based, so an Australian brand would need a local partner.
